exposure: minimal bathing routine intervention (package of support)
outcome: identification of barriers and facilitators to minimal infant bathing
development and refinement of a prototype intervention package
cohort: The study included pregnant women and their families (n=31), multidisciplinary experts and Patient and Public Involvement and Engagement (PPIE) representatives (n=13), and families (n=5) for an intervention walkthrough.
finding: The study successfully developed an evidence-based package of support, incorporating the views of families and experts, to facilitate a minimal infant bathing routine by addressing identified social influences and motivational factors.
